Manual payment
1. Send UGX 1,000 to the KICHS admin mobile-money number: 0706123923.
2. Choose the network you used below.
3. Enter the number you paid from and the transaction ID/reference from your SMS.
4. Submit the payment for admin verification.

Your transaction ID is used by the admin to confirm that the UGX 1,000 was received.

Privacy and Security

Lock Account
An additional lock for your already signed-in app
lock

Set a private code. KICHS will lock automatically when you leave the app.

Your code is hashed on this device; the original code is not stored. When the app is locked, unlocking takes you directly to the Student Dashboard without another sign-in.

Lock Account is ON

Your app locks automatically when you leave it. You can turn this feature off after confirming your current security code.

Fingerprint / Biometric Security

Check whether this device supports a built-in biometric authenticator. Secure fingerprint enrollment will be connected separately; the PIN/password lock remains available as the fallback.

Theme Change

Choose how KICHS Student App looks on this device. Your choice is saved separately for your student account.

About the App

The KICHS Student App is an official digital platform developed for students of Kiryokya College of Health Sciences. It brings essential college services and information together in one convenient place. Students can access academic resources, manage their student account, receive college announcements and notifications, view payment and verification updates, submit complaints and communicate with the college administration.

Our Mission
To embrace digital innovation in delivering efficient student services, improving communication and supporting quality health sciences education.
